description: This file defines the PipelineExecution class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a data pipeline, including starting, running, validating, and stopping pipeline execution within a Spark-based data processing framework.

classes.name: PipelineExecution
classes.description: Manages the execution lifecycle of a data pipeline, including starting, running, validating, and stopping the pipeline, with support for event logging and error handling.

methods.name: executionStarted
methods.description: Checks if the pipeline execution has started by verifying if the graph execution is non-empty.

methods.name: startPipeline
methods.description: Initializes and starts the pipeline execution by resolving the graph, materializing datasets, and launching the execution thread.

methods.name: runPipeline
methods.description: Starts the pipeline and waits for its completion, handling exceptions and logging failures.

methods.name: dryRunPipeline
methods.description: Validates the pipeline graph without executing it, primarily for testing or validation purposes.

methods.name: constructTerminationEvent
methods.description: Constructs a pipeline event indicating termination status based on the provided reason.

methods.name: resolveGraph
methods.description: Resolves and validates the pipeline's data flow graph, handling unresolved pipeline exceptions.

methods.name: awaitCompletion
methods.description: Waits for the current pipeline execution to complete.

methods.name: handleInvalidPipeline
methods.description: Logs failures related to unresolved pipeline components, distinguishing between upstream and downstream errors.

methods.name: stopPipeline
methods.description: Stops the ongoing pipeline execution thread.
